about: Minor rows whose rule depends on the student's major, derived by outside-major-holdout.ts from the majors themselves. Re-run `npx tsx outside-major-holdout.ts --all --check` after a major is added or re-authored (and --write, expand-draft, the ledger and promote for each row it flags). mode: major = courses the major counts plus its own subjects; department = every course of the major's department subjects and their cross-listings; courses = the holdOut courses, for majors whose own requirements name any of the requires courses. output: absent = a hold-out inside the row's rule; limit = a limits entry on the row (maxCourses over the major's courses, or minCourses over the courses outside it).

limit.label: At most one from your major's department
At least one elective from outside your major
